questions.question_text: Choose the correct ascending order of growth rate (slowest to fastest):
options: $O(\log n), O(n), O(n \log n), O(n^2), O(2^n)$
$O(n), O(\log n), O(n \log n), O(2^n), O(n^2)$
$O(n \log n), O(n), O(\log n), O(n^2), O(2^n)$
$O(n^2), O(n), O(\log n), O(n \log n), O(2^n)$
questions.answer: The correct ascending order of standard time complexity classes is logarithmic ($O(\log n)$), linear ($O(n)$), linearithmic ($O(n \log n)$), quadratic ($O(n^2)$), and exponential ($O(2^n)$).

questions.question_text:
How is the second element in an array accessed using pointer notation?

```c
int arr[5] = {10, 20, 30, 40, 50};

```
questions.answer: `arr` decays to a pointer to the first element, so the second element is `*(arr + 1)`.
